uplink.description: 0x57 Temp 4 periodic data, 2 channels, with trailing timestamp: one channels[] entry per probe, each t=0 sample -> temperature
uplink._note: Both probe channels are sub-sensor positions: one channels[] entry each (labels channel1/channel2), carrying temperature for the current (t=0) sample plus that channel's [t=0, t-1, ...] series as the temperatureSamples extra (no per-sample time exists, so no reserved history array). Frame counter, low-battery flag and the device timestamp stay top-level.

uplink.description: 0x30 keep-alive, 2 channels active, no timestamp: distinct current sample per channel
0x30 keep-alive, single channel, no timestamp: only the channel1 entry is emitted
uplink._note: Status bit4 clear -> 1-channel mode: the payload carries no channel-2 samples, so no channel2 entry is emitted (disconnected-position policy).

uplink.description: configuration frame (0x10) is not periodic telemetry
